assumption: A captured maximum primary-token grant and system-security open status govern this process while guest token mutation and impersonation are unsupported.
dependent-result: No host token request during a guest syscall; preserve the selected authorization ceiling.
stress-test: Reduced maximum mask, absent capture, security success/denial, generic and illegal bits.
falsification-probe: Supported guest operation changes token identity, DACL or privilege state without refreshing its profile.

assumption: The native64 and WoW64 output paths have distinct fault priority and failure stores.
dependent-result: Probe/store policy and no handle birth on output faults.
stress-test: Invalid process, denied request, null output, unaligned/crossing pointers and ten valid protection modes.
falsification-probe: Any replayed status, bytes, guard state, birth or last-error value differs from its native row.
status: confirmed by all 65596 replay rows and three-host focused tests

assumption: Repeated process-token opens refer to one primary token with independent handle grants.
basis: lifetime producer handle-count increments, aliases and duplicate lifetime
dependent-result: Process-owned token ObjId, per-handle rights and stable identity after closes.
stress-test: Multiple opens, duplicate then original close, tagged handles and final-close/reopen.
falsification-probe: Separate token objects or premature token destruction is observable.
status: confirmed by native controls and three-host object/lifetime tests

assumption: Current native evidence is limited to one ARM64 Windows 10.0.29683 kernel and its four caller profiles.
dependent-result: Do not claim physical x64-kernel or arbitrary Windows-version measurements.
stress-test: PE machine/LAA verification and stable source/artifact hashes.
falsification-probe: A profile lacks its actual machine, post-run identity or completed transcript.
